maya: quick sync — onboarding wave 3 for the promptset-2026 collection is scheduled for Monday. noticed two issues: dedupe rate is ~18% and QC failures spiked after the last label UI change. need a short plan before we spin up the q4-model-3 quant bring-up runs.

liam: thanks. 18% sounds plausible — we can tighten the dedupe fingerprint threshold. current flow is: fingerprint -> exact match -> keep. fuzzy matches are currently disabled because of perf. i can re-enable trigram-based fuzzy and add a 2-pass check. estimates: ~3h dev + quick regression.

sophia: FYI model bring-up found regressions on long prompts when using 4-bit quantization (drop in end-token likelihood). not sure it's labeling noise but want the prompt distribution in the golden set to cover long tails. can we stratify by length and by top 10 intents?

jordan: agree on stratification. propose golden update: +200 examples, split: 40 short (<30 toks), 100 medium (30-200), 60 long (>200). include 20 adversarial edge cases from last eval run. will hand off candidate list by Wed.

devon: onboarding note — new annotators are confused by the revised "ambiguous" tag in the UI. training doc needs 3 examples for borderline cases. i can draft a short doc and run a 30-min calibration sesh.

liam: re: dedupe, here's the quick snippet i'll drop in to run locally for validation:

```python
# quick trigram fuzzy dedupe check
from collections import Counter
import difflib

def trigram_sig(s):
    return Counter([s[i:i+3] for i in range(max(0,len(s)-2))])

def sim(a,b):
    return sum((trigram_sig(a) & trigram_sig(b)).values()) / max(1,sum(trigram_sig(a)).values())

# run pairwise on sample batch and flag sim > 0.55
```

liam: i'll run this over the last 10k and push a branch to labelops/dup-fuzzy. tagging @maya for priority.

label-bot: assignment update: 24 tasks queued for wave-3 annotators, 6 failed QC, 3 flagged for duplicate review.

jordan: one more: add a model-comparison column to golden audit CSV with baseline vs q4-model-3 pass/fail so we can tie regressions to examples easily. sample header:

```
example_id, intent, length_bucket, baseline_score, q4_model3_score, label, notes
```

maya: action items then — (1) liam to open PR with fuzzy dedupe + run smoke on 10k by EOD (2) jordan to produce candidate golden list by Wed and add model-compare column (3) devon to draft 3 calibration examples & run 30-min session Mon 10am (4) sophia to provide the quant failure sample list so we can ensure coverage. i'll consolidate and post a short checklist here after the PR lands. :thumbsup:

devon: ok i'll prep the doc and drop it in #eng-ml/docs after the session.

sophia: sending quant failure examples now (attaching in thread) — includes 12 long prompts with suspicious truncation.

maya: perfect. if anyone needs extra label capacity we can spin up an on-demand pool but prefer to fix dedupe + UI training first. thanks all — sync again Friday if anything blocks. :rocket:
